statement: Before calling a PR's red a flake, read the same test on main's own latest CI run. Incident: on 2026-11-04 the reviewing session saw cejel #657 fail one wall-clock scan guard at 2,036 ms against 2,000, measured #657 against main locally (about 820 ms each), called it runner variance and handed the operator a re-run. The re-run failed at 2,070 ms, and main's CI at 30672787b had already failed the same guard at 2,003 ms. The PR was never the cause, and the re-run cost about 20 minutes. Fix: when a PR fails a test its diff does not obviously touch, open main's latest CI run first; if main fails it too, fix main and do not re-run the PR. Rule: a flake is a claim that main passes the same test; check that before asking for a re-run.

movesWhen.reason: A review-method error: no code change fixes it; the rule is to read main's latest CI run for the same test before calling a PR's failure a flake.
